biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common in genomically complex UPS; not established as a routine clinical prognostic biomarker

biomarkers.name: Complex karyotype
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic of UPS; genomically complex sarcoma without a recurrent specific driver alteration

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 / TMB
biomarkers.clinical_use: No validated biomarker standard; pembrolizumab showed activity in a subset in SARC028, and UPS is among the more immune-responsive sarcoma subtypes

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Pleomorphic spindle and epithelioid cells without identifiable lineage differentiation by IHC or molecular studies — diagnosis of exclusion
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Usually FNCLCC high-grade; UPS is typically a high-grade pleomorphic sarcoma

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: One of the more inflamed sarcoma subtypes — tertiary lymphoid structures identified in some — supports IO responses in a subset
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Pleomorphic architecture; storiform pattern in some variants

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — undifferentiated mesenchymal cells without identifiable lineage differentiation by IHC or molecular studies
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated by definition — pleomorphic spindle and epithelioid cells without identifiable lineage markers (though focal aberrant expression of markers can occur)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Category has narrowed as molecular studies identify specific entities (dedifferentiated liposarcoma, MPNST, pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma, etc.); represents diagnosis of exclusion after thorough workup
